# A. Distance data

```{r,fig.width=8.5}
overall_pair_types_index <- overall_pair_types %>% subset(index1==T & index2==T & subject_id1==subject_id2) %>% subset(visit1==0 | visit2==0)
overall_pair_types_index$non_index_visit <- ifelse(overall_pair_types_index$visit1==0,overall_pair_types_index$visit2,overall_pair_types_index$visit1)
 
prologed_results <- persistent_colonization_by_threshold %>% subset(threshold==25)
df_index <- left_join(df_index,prologed_results %>% mutate(prolonged_colonization = index_at_1_and_or_2))
df_index$prolonged_colonization <- ifelse(is.na(df_index$prolonged_colonization),"No index specimen",
                                          ifelse(df_index$prolonged_colonization==1,"Yes","No"))

overall_pair_types_index <- overall_pair_types_index %>%
  left_join(df_index %>% select(subject_id, prolonged_colonization) %>% distinct, 
            by = c("subject_id1" = "subject_id"))

household_order <- overall_pair_types_index %>%
  subset(Species_ST1==Species_ST2) %>%
  group_by(household1) %>%
  summarise(
    median_dist = median(gubbins_masked_noncore),
    any_prolonged = any(prolonged_colonization == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(any_prolonged), median_dist) %>%
  pull(household1)

overall_pair_types_index$household1 <- factor(overall_pair_types_index$household1, 
                                               levels = household_order)

ST_pairs <- overall_pair_types_index %>% subset(Species_ST1 == Species_ST2)
A <- ggplot(data = ST_pairs ,
            aes(x = as.factor(non_index_visit), y = gubbins_masked_noncore, group = subject_id1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 18, color = 'red', linetype = 2,linewidth = 0.5,alpha=0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(color = prolonged_colonization), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(color = prolonged_colonization), size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~household1, ncol = 5)  +
  theme_bw_me +
  labs(y     = "SNP distance from index isolate",
       x     = "Study visit",
       color = "Persistent colonization") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1" = "Baseline", "2" = "One\nmonth", "3" = "Two\nmonth")) + scale_color_manual(
    breaks = c("Yes", "No", "No index specimen"),
    values = c("Yes" = "darkred", "No" = "gray60", "No index specimen" = "gray85"),
    name   = "Persistent colonization"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2))  +scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max(ST_pairs$gubbins_masked_noncore) / 25) * 25, by = 25),
    limits = c(0, max(ST_pairs$gubbins_masked_noncore) * 1.175),
  expand = expansion(add = c(5, 0.25))
  ) + theme(axis.text = element_text(color='black')) + theme(
    legend.margin   = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(1, "mm"),
    panel.spacing   = unit(1, "mm"),
    plot.margin     = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, "mm")
  ) + 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=12,color='black'),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=12,color='black'),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10,color='black'),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10,color='black')) +  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.6125, 0.0285),   
    legend.justification = c(0, 0)
  ) + geom_text(aes(label = gubbins_masked_noncore, color = prolonged_colonization),
          size = 2.25, vjust = -0.8, show.legend = FALSE)

A
```
# B. Persistent colonization by threshold
```{r}
household_w_index <- df_index %>% subset(visit==0) %>% .$household %>% sort

prolonged_df <- persistent_colonization_by_threshold %>% group_by(threshold) %>% summarise(num_prolonged = sum(index_at_1_and_or_2))
 
B <- ggplot(data=prolonged_df,aes(x=threshold,y=num_prolonged))  + geom_vline(xintercept = 18, color='red', linetype=2, alpha=0.5)   + geom_line(linewidth=1,colour = 'black') + theme_bw_me + labs(x="SNP distance threshold", y="Persistent colonization\nevents") + scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(5))   + scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(8),limits = c(0,18)) + 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=12,color='black'),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=12,color='black'),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10,color='black'),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10,color='black'))

B
```

# C. Dynamics over time
```{r} 
household_over_time_dynamics <- persistent_colonization_by_threshold %>%
  select(household, threshold, index_at_1_and_or_2) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = threshold,
    values_from = index_at_1_and_or_2
  )
household_over_time_dynamics <- column_to_rownames(household_over_time_dynamics,'household')
cols_to_show <- as.character(seq(0, 100, by = 20))
col_labels <- ifelse(colnames(household_over_time_dynamics) %in% as.character(seq(0, 100, by = 20)),
                     colnames(household_over_time_dynamics),
                     "")

C <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(household_over_time_dynamics %>% subset(rowSums(.)>0),cluster_columns = F,name = 'Persistent\ncolonization',col=c("white",'black'),column_title = "SNP distance threshold",column_names_centered = T,column_names_rot = 0,
  column_labels         = col_labels, 
        heatmap_legend_param = list(
          title = "Persistent\ncolonization",
          at = c(1, 0),                  # The exact values/breaks on your data scale
          labels = c("Yes", "No")  # Your custom key names for those breaks
          ,
  border = TRUE,
  gap    = unit(3, "mm")
        ),border = T,
  column_title_side = 'bottom',
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize=12, fontface = "plain"),
  ht_opt(TITLE_PADDING = unit(1, "mm")),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize=10, fontface = "plain"),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize=10, fontface = "plain"))

C
```

# D. Pairwise concordance
```{r}
similarity_dataset_index <- lapply(0:100, FUN = function(x) {
    ref_col <- "Species_ST_cluster_18"
    col_name <- paste0("Species_ST_cluster_", x)
    
    SNP_clustering <- clustering_across_thresholds_ST_preferred %>%
        select(genomic_id, all_of(ref_col), all_of(col_name)) %>%
        subset(genomic_id %in% df_index$genomic_id)
    
    ref_clusters <- SNP_clustering[[ref_col]]
    threshold_clusters <- SNP_clustering[[col_name]]
    
    co_cluster_ref <- outer(ref_clusters, ref_clusters, "==")
    co_cluster_threshold <- outer(threshold_clusters, threshold_clusters, "==")
    pair_concordance <- mean((co_cluster_ref == co_cluster_threshold)[lower.tri(co_cluster_ref)])
    
    data.frame(
        threshold            = x,
        ARI                  = mclust::adjustedRandIndex(ref_clusters, threshold_clusters),
        pairwise_concordance = pair_concordance,
        isolates             = nrow(SNP_clustering)
    )
}) %>%
    bind_rows()

D <- ggplot(data=similarity_dataset_index,aes(x=threshold,y=pairwise_concordance)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 18,color='red',linetype=2,alpha=0.5) + geom_hline(yintercept = 1,alpha=0.125)  + geom_line(linewidth=1,colour = 'black') + theme_bw_me + labs(x="SNP distance threshold", y="Pairwise concordance\n(≤18 SNP reference)") + scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(5)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(8)) + 
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=12,color='black'),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size=12,color='black'),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size=10,color='black'),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size=10,color='black'))
D
```

# Final figure

```{r,fig.height=10.625,fig.width=8.5}
# Align B and D on left axis
aligned <- cowplot::align_plots(B, D, align = "v", axis = "l")
B_aligned <- aligned[[1]]
D_aligned <- aligned[[2]]

# Build figure components
C_fig <- grid::grid.grabExpr(draw(C))
B_fig <- cowplot::plot_grid(B_aligned, NULL, ncol=1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.00001))
BC_figure <- cowplot::plot_grid(B_fig, C_fig, ncol=2, labels = c("B","C"), rel_widths = c(0.8, 1))
D_fig <- cowplot::plot_grid(D_aligned, NULL, ncol=2, rel_widths = c(0.8, 1))

# Assemble full figure
s_figure_2 <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    A,
    BC_figure,
    D_fig,
    ncol=1,
    rel_heights = c(1, 0.475, 0.475),
    labels = c("A","","D")
)

s_figure_2
```
